title: Ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent degradation of HIF-1alpha by cannabidiol disrupts pro-angiogenic synoviocyte-endothelial crosstalk in rheumatoid arthritis.
authors: Chen, Jing; Li, Gejing; Zhao, Fang; Zhang, Ye; Mu, Qingrui; Zhang, Junlan; Cai, Xiong; Tang, Yuanyuan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨CBD通过泛素-蛋白酶体途径降解HIF-1α抑制类风湿关节炎滑膜血管生成，属于纯湿实验与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cannabidiol (CBD), a major non-psychoactive phytocannabinoid derived from Cannabis sativa L., has shown therapeutic potential in rheumatoid arthritis (RA). However, the mechanisms by which CBD modulates synovial angiogenesis remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate whether CBD attenuates RA progression by suppressing synovial angiogenesis and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: An adjuvant-induced arthritis (AIA) rat model was established to evaluate the therapeutic effects of CBD in vivo using arthritis scoring, micro-CT, and histopathological, immunohistochemical, and immunofluorescence analyses. In vitro, cytotoxicity was determined using the CCK-8 assay, followed by evaluations of CBD's direct effects on the proliferation, migration, invasion, and inflammatory responses of RA fibroblast-like synoviocytes (RA-FLS) were evaluated, alongside Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) for cytotoxicity screening. Furthermore, the paracrine regulation of angiogenesis was assessed using a conditioned medium (CM) transfer system from hypoxia-stimulated RA-FLS applied to human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). Molecular mechanisms were analyzed via Western blotting, RT-qPCR, ELISA, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), molecular docking, and targeted proteasome inhibition (MG132). RESULTS: In vivo, CBD (5 and 10 mg/kg) treatment markedly alleviated joint inflammation, synovial angiogenesis, and structural bone destruction in AIA rats. In vitro, non-cytotoxic concentrations of CBD (2.4-4.8 muM) significantly suppressed aberrant RA-FLS proliferation, migration, invasion, and pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion. Mechanistically, CBD abrogated the hypoxia-induced accumulation of hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) protein in RA-FLS without significantly altering HIF1A mRNA expression. This reduction was effectively reversed by MG132. Co-IP and molecular docking analyses revealed that CBD directly enhances the polyubiquitination of HIF-1alpha through stable structural interactions, driving a ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent degradation mechanism. Consequently, CBD dose-dependently decreased the extracellular secretion of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA) and angiopoietin-2 (ANG-2) from RA-FLS. Functionally, CM from CBD-treated RA-FLS disrupted the pro-angiogenic paracrine crosstalk-independent of direct CBD carryover-significantly impairing HUVEC migration, capillary-like tube formation, and downstream VEGFR2 (Tyr1175) phosphorylation. CONCLUSION: CBD attenuates RA pathogenesis not only by directly suppressing RA-FLS hyperactivity but also by severing the pro-angiogenic paracrine crosstalk between RA-FLS and endothelial cells. These effects are driven by the ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent degradation of HIF-1alpha in RA-FLS via direct structural engagement, which depletes VEGFA/ANG-2 production and subsequent endothelial VEGFR2 activation. These findings highlight CBD as a promising disease-modifying anti-angiogenic therapeutic agent for RA.
abstract_zh: 背景：大麻二酚（Cannabidiol, CBD）是一种源自大麻（Cannabis sativa L.）的主要非精神活性植物大麻素，在类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）中显示出治疗潜力。然而，CBD调节滑膜血管生成的机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨CBD是否通过抑制滑膜血管生成来减轻RA进展，并阐明其潜在分子机制。方法：建立佐剂诱导性关节炎（adjuvant-induced arthritis, AIA）大鼠模型，通过关节炎评分、micro-CT、组织病理学、免疫组织化学和免疫荧光分析评估CBD在体内的治疗效果。体外实验中，使用CCK-8法测定细胞毒性，随后评估CBD对RA成纤维样滑膜细胞（RA fibroblast-like synoviocytes, RA-FLS）增殖、迁移、侵袭和炎症反应的直接影响，同时使用Cell Counting Kit-8（CCK-8）进行细胞毒性筛选。此外，通过将缺氧刺激的RA-FLS条件培养基（conditioned medium, CM）转移至人脐静脉内皮细胞（human umbilical vein endothelial cells, HUVECs），评估血管生成的旁分泌调节。分子机制通过Western blotting、RT-qPCR、ELISA、免疫共沉淀（co-immunoprecipitation, Co-IP）、分子对接和靶向蛋白酶体抑制（MG132）进行分析。结果：在体内，CBD（5和10 mg/kg）治疗显著减轻了AIA大鼠的关节炎症、滑膜血管生成和结构性骨破坏。在体外，非细胞毒性浓度的CBD（2.4-4.8 μM）显著抑制了RA-FLS的异常增殖、迁移、侵袭和促炎细胞因子分泌。机制上，CBD消除了缺氧诱导的RA-FLS中缺氧诱导因子-1α（hypoxia-inducible factor-1α, HIF-1α）蛋白积累，而不显著改变HIF1A mRNA表达。这种减少被MG132有效逆转。Co-IP和分子对接分析揭示，CBD通过稳定的结构相互作用直接增强HIF-1α的多聚泛素化，驱动泛素-蛋白酶体依赖性降解机制。因此，CBD剂量依赖性地降低了RA-FLS分泌的血管内皮生长因子A（vascular endothelial growth factor A, VEGFA）和血管生成素-2（angiopoietin-2, ANG-2）的细胞外分泌。功能上，来自CBD处理的RA-FLS的CM破坏了促血管生成的旁分泌串扰——独立于直接CBD残留——显著损害了HUVEC迁移、毛细管样管形成以及下游VEGFR2（Tyr1175）磷酸化。结论：CBD通过直接抑制RA-FLS过度活跃以及切断RA-FLS与内皮细胞之间的促血管生成旁分泌串扰来减轻RA发病机制。这些效应由CBD通过直接结构结合驱动RA-FLS中HIF-1α的泛素-蛋白酶体依赖性降解所介导，从而耗竭VEGFA/ANG-2产生及随后的内皮VEGFR2激活。这些发现突显了CBD作为RA的一种有前景的疾病修饰性抗血管生成治疗剂。
